data.text: Glad we could all meet before heading out. My family’s fished this lake for years, and I want it to keep supporting our village. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50 to reproduce, and have 100 again next month. That’s $10,000 apiece each month if we stick to it. I’ll commit to that limit and sharing my catch honestly. How does that sound to everyone? John?
